The EMIS rollout included attendance and behaviour modules.Learning PassportandADT serieswere completed and featured in the ministry&39;s summer academy. To date, over 8,000 users have been engaged, and 1,000 educators trained on these tools potentially impacting 140,000 students. Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR) PFA focused sessions and materials including PFA school-based kits reached 15,000 students across the 45 most affected schools in response to Hurricane Beryl.;;;
